PMS Design System Specification: Default Brand Primary is Rose Luxury (#C7346A / oklch(0.57 0.215 355)), with --primary-pressed: oklch(0.495 0.22 355) and --primary-tint: oklch(0.952 0.06 350).
Current Retrod POS State: POS :root is configured with Brand Teal (#0f766e / #115e59 / #f0fdfa). Rose is only present as an auxiliary class '.theme-rose-indigo-premium'.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Default app look is Teal/Green rather than unified Retrod Brand Rose. Theme switcher is required to see Rose.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Set Rose Luxury as default :root in styles.css and update --primary, --primary-pressed, --primary-tint tokens.

PMS Design System Specification: Canvas Background is vibrant soft rose canvas: oklch(0.975 0.038 338), --surface: #FFFFFF, --surface-2: oklch(0.958 0.05 332).
Current Retrod POS State: POS :root uses light beige/off-white #f6f5f0, --surface: #ffffff, --surface-2: #eae9e3.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Background gives a warm off-white/beige tint rather than the luxury rose canvas of the Retrod PMS design system.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update :root --background and --surface-2 in src/styles.css to match the OKLCH rose canvas definitions.

PMS Design System Specification: Strict High-Contrast Text Standard: --text-primary: #000000 (100% black), --text-secondary: #000000, --text-disabled: #64748b (Slate 500).
Current Retrod POS State: POS :root uses --text-primary: oklch(0.198 0.022 264) (#111827) and --text-secondary: oklch(0.49 0.12 330).
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: POS uses dark charcoal instead of strict pure black text (#000000) for highest readability in operational environments.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update CSS variables --text-primary and --text-secondary to #000000 and ensure input typography reflects this standard.

PMS Design System Specification: Elevation Shadows with Rose Tint: --shadow-e1 (0 1px 3px rgba(170,24,87,0.14)), --shadow-e2 (0 4px 12px rgba(170,24,87,0.2)), --shadow-e3 (0 8px 24px rgba(170,24,87,0.28)).
Current Retrod POS State: POS styles.css defines --shadow-e1, --shadow-e2, --shadow-e3 matching the rose rgba(170, 24, 87) values in @theme inline.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Shadow tokens exist and match the spec.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Verify all card and modal primitives properly consume shadow-e1, shadow-e2, and shadow-e3 classes.

PMS Design System Specification: Corner Radii Tokens: rounded-sm (4px), rounded-md (6px), rounded-lg (8px), rounded-xl (10px).
Current Retrod POS State: POS styles.css defines --radius-sm: 4px, --radius-md: 6px, --radius-lg: 8px, --radius-xl: 10px in @theme inline.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Token scale matches spec perfectly.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Ensure custom components do not use non-standard border radius (e.g. rounded-2xl or rounded-full where not intended).

PMS Design System Specification: 3-Font Semantic Hierarchy: Playfair Display (Display/Titles), DM Sans (Interface/Body), JetBrains Mono (Data/Prices/Codes/Numbers).
Current Retrod POS State: Google Fonts import in styles.css imports all 3 fonts (DM Sans, Playfair Display, JetBrains Mono) and binds to font-sans, font-display, font-mono.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Fonts are correctly imported and configured in Tailwind theme.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Maintain strict usage across components so numbers/currency always receive font-mono.

PMS Design System Specification: Section Labels (.label-uppercase): text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-primary.
Current Retrod POS State: POS .label-uppercase is defined as font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-secondary).
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Font weight is 500 (medium) instead of bold (700), and color is text-secondary rather than high-contrast text-primary.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update .label-uppercase utility in src/styles.css to use font-weight: 700 and color: var(--color-text-primary).

PMS Design System Specification: Eyebrow Micro-Typography: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary mb-0.5.
Current Retrod POS State:
PageHeader in Primitives.tsx uses
{eyebrow}
which resolves to text-secondary.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Eyebrows lack brand rose primary color (text-primary) and bold weight.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update PageHeader in Primitives.tsx to use text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary mb-0.5.

PMS Design System Specification: Page Titles: font-display text-[20px] font-bold leading-tight text-text-primary sm:text-[22px].
Current Retrod POS State: PageHeader in Primitives.tsx uses font-display text-[22px] font-semibold leading-tight text-text-primary sm:text-[26px].
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Font weight is semibold (600) instead of bold (700), and scale is slightly oversized compared to PMS spec.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Adjust PageHeader title styling to font-display text-[20px] font-bold leading-tight text-text-primary sm:text-[22px].

PMS Design System Specification: Currency & Data Monospace: All prices must be formatted as ₹{amount.toLocaleString()} with font-mono.
Current Retrod POS State: Prices across various POS screens use ₹ but some lack font-mono or have inconsistent locale formatting.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Inconsistent font-mono tags across order item lists, catalog grids, and receipt templates.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Enforce a shared PriceDisplay / currency helper component that guarantees ₹ prefix, .toLocaleString(), and font-mono.

PMS Design System Specification: PageHeader Banner: border-b border-primary/20 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-tint/40 via-primary/5 to-surface px-4 py-3.5 sm:px-6 sm:py-4 shadow-xs.
Current Retrod POS State: POS PageHeader uses flat plain border: border-b border-border bg-surface px-4 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:gap-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-5.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Lacks the luxury rose-tinted background gradient and subtle primary border accent that characterizes the Retrod suite.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update PageHeader component in Primitives.tsx with the specified gradient classes and responsive padding.

PMS Design System Specification: KpiCard: Left accent border pill (w-[3px] in brand, success, warning, error, info), font-mono text-[24px] sm:text-[28px] font-bold.
Current Retrod POS State: POS KpiCard uses w-[2px] pill and font-mono text-[22px] font-semibold sm:text-[26px].
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Accent pill width is 2px (less visible) and number scale is 22px semibold instead of 24px-28px bold.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update KpiCard in Primitives.tsx to w-[3px] accent bar and font-mono text-[24px] sm:text-[28px] font-bold.

PMS Design System Specification: StatusBadge: Filled dot bullet (h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-current), semantic toneClasses (success green, warning amber, error red, info indigo, neutral).
Current Retrod POS State: POS StatusBadge has filled dot, but maps 'success' to 'bg-primary-tint text-primary-pressed' (teal) rather than true Emerald Green.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Success tone uses brand primary rather than semantic green (--color-success / --color-success-tint).
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update toneClasses in Primitives.tsx: success -> bg-success-tint text-success, brand -> bg-primary-tint text-primary.

PMS Design System Specification: Button Variants: primary (bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-pressed shadow-e1), outline (border border-border bg-surface text-black font-semibold), ghost (text-black), danger (bg-error-tint text-error). Includes active:scale-[0.98].
Current Retrod POS State: src/components/ui/button.tsx has hardcoded Tailwind classes (bg-teal-600, border-slate-300, text-slate-700). Primitives.tsx Button has partial tokens.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Two competing Button components; ui/button.tsx hardcodes teal and slate colors instead of consuming CSS variables.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Align src/components/ui/button.tsx with design tokens (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, danger) and active:scale-[0.98].

PMS Design System Specification: Input / Select Fields: Pure black text (#000000), crisp slate placeholders (#64748b), border-input, ring focus.
Current Retrod POS State: POS input.tsx uses placeholder:text-muted-foreground and generic md:text-sm without explicit high-contrast black text.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Placeholders and typed text rely on muted tokens that can appear washed out in bright POS terminal environments.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Standardize input.tsx & select triggers with text-[#000000] (dark:text-white) and placeholder:text-[#64748b].

PMS Design System Specification: Toast Notifications: Use Sonner with corresponding Lucide icons for all user feedback (ticket dispatch, settlement, errors).
Current Retrod POS State: Sonner is installed in package.json and toaster is rendered in layout, but some actions lack rich icon toasts.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Foundation is in place and working.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Standardize toast.success/error calls across all POS mutations with consistent wording and icons.

PMS Design System Specification: DataTableHeader Component: Global search bar, column customization (reorder, visibility, pinning), Excel/CSV export, bulk actions.
Current Retrod POS State: POS has a comprehensive DataTableHeader.tsx (90KB) in src/components/common/ with full column menu, filters, and export logic.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Feature-complete DataTableHeader matching the PMS architecture.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Verify column header styling uses text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary.

PMS Design System Specification: Table Typography: Header text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary, cell text-[13px]/[14px].
Current Retrod POS State: Table components in src/components/ui/table.tsx and data-grid apply standard classes, mostly aligned.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Table layout and typography follow dense operational standards.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Ensure monetary table columns (Total, Balance, Tax) consistently use font-mono.

PMS Design System Specification: Pagination: Sticky footer pagination with page size selector (10, 25, 50, 100).
Current Retrod POS State: POS DataGrid and table components support pagination and size selection.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Standardized pagination present.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Ensure consistent active page indicator styling across all tabular screens.

PMS Design System Specification: Direct Exporting: Support direct Excel (exportToExcel) and CSV streaming.
Current Retrod POS State: DataTableHeader.tsx includes export handlers.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Ensure all data grids (Billing ledger, orders history, inventory) enable the export button by default.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Connect export hooks across all manager views.

PMS Design System Specification: 2-Column Split Layout: Left column (65%-70%) for Product Grid & Search, Right column (350px-400px fixed) for Cart & Checkout.
Current Retrod POS State: POS has take-order wizard / catalog step with 2-column layout, but split proportions and responsive drawer behavior vary between desktop/mobile.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Layout exists but spacing, column locking, and split ratios need exact alignment with the spec.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Standardize Terminal container as flex/grid with 65-70% catalog area and fixed 380px cart summary panel.

PMS Design System Specification: Product Grid & Fast Search: Horizontal category chip bar (All, Foods, Drinks, Snacks, Desserts), search bar with '/' keyboard hotkey & barcode scanner listener.
Current Retrod POS State: Category tabs exist in catalog step, but fast '/' hotkey autofocus and barcode scanning hooks are missing or unlinked.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Visual categories exist; keyboard autofocus hotkey '/' and barcode scanner listener need implementation.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Add keydown listener for '/' hotkey to auto-focus product search input and hook up barcode scanner input handler.

PMS Design System Specification: Item Product Tiles: Category badge, food type icon (Veg 🟢 / Non-Veg 🔴 / Vegan / Egg), item title, monospace price tag (₹450), min-height 40-48px touch targets.
Current Retrod POS State: Catalog tiles display title, price, and category, but Veg/Non-Veg indicators and touch target heights are inconsistent.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Food type badge indicators (Veg dot / Non-Veg triangle) are not uniformly styled across all item cards.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Implement unified FoodTypeIcon component (Veg = green square with dot, Non-Veg = brown square with triangle) and ensure 44px+ touch targets.

PMS Design System Specification: Cart & Order Basket Panel: Scrollable itemized list with rapid '+' / '-' quantity steppers, modifier lists, item delete button, high touch targets.
Current Retrod POS State: Cart panel exists in order wizard, with quantity adjustment and item removal.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Stepper buttons need tactile active:scale-[0.98] feedback and larger touch padding (min 36px-40px).
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Refactor cart item row steppers with explicit + / - touch buttons and itemized modifier pill tags.

PMS Design System Specification: Cart Footer & Total: Discount popover, Tax breakdown, Monospace Grand Total (font-mono text-[22px] font-bold text-primary).
Current Retrod POS State: Total is displayed, but monospace styling and primary brand coloring are inconsistent.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Grand total does not consistently use font-mono text-[22px] font-bold text-primary.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Update cart footer with high-visibility grand total in font-mono and dedicated Discount / Tax breakdown popover.

PMS Design System Specification: Primary Action Buttons: Big dual action buttons: [ Send KOT ] (Dispatches to kitchen) and [ Pay & Settle ] (Opens Payment Modal).
Current Retrod POS State: Buttons exist in order wizard footer, but naming and styling vary across steps.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Button labels vary (e.g. 'Place Order', 'Submit', 'Next') instead of standard [ Send KOT ] and [ Pay & Settle ].
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Standardize order screen footer with prominent [ Send KOT ] (secondary/outline) and [ Pay & Settle ] (primary brand rose).

PMS Design System Specification: KDS Top Metrics: Active tickets count, average preparation time, overdue alerts (>15 mins).
Current Retrod POS State: PosKotManager.tsx displays ticket counts and summary stats.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Top metrics cards are present in KOT manager.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Ensure metric numbers use font-mono and match KpiCard primitive styling.

PMS Design System Specification: Kanban Status Columns: Queued (Yellow/Warning), Preparing (Blue/Info), Ready (Green/Success) with live ticking timers in font-mono.
Current Retrod POS State: PosKotManager.tsx has status columns and card lists, but color borders and live timer badges need tighter alignment.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Column headers and timers exist, but live seconds ticking and overdue color pulsing (>15 min) need refinement.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Add live useInterval ticking timer badge to each ticket card with warning pulse if overdue >15m.

PMS Design System Specification: KOT Ticket Card Details: Table/Room badge, Captain name, item list with highlighted kitchen notes (e.g. 'Less spicy', 'No onion').
Current Retrod POS State: Ticket cards show items, but customer notes are rendered in plain text rather than highlighted warning badges.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Kitchen notes need visual emphasis (yellow highlight chip) to prevent chef prep errors.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Style item special instructions / notes with bg-warning-tint text-warning font-semibold chip.

PMS Design System Specification: One-Tap Action Buttons on Tickets: [ Start Cooking ], [ Mark Ready ], [ Print Duplicate KOT ].
Current Retrod POS State: Action buttons exist on ticket cards.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Ensure button labels and mutation status transitions match the exact Queued -> Preparing -> Ready flow.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Standardize KOT card action triggers with tactile button primitives.

PMS Design System Specification: Multi-Tender Selection: Quick tender tabs/icons: Cash, Credit/Debit Card, UPI / Dynamic QR, Room Charge (Folio), Digital Wallet, Gift Card.
Current Retrod POS State: POS has billing and payment dialogs, but tender options are split across multiple disparate dialogs.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Payment modal lacks a unified multi-tender split view where multiple payment methods can be applied to a single check.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Create/Refactor PaymentModal with multi-tender split inputs and clear method switcher icons.

PMS Design System Specification: Quick Cash Denomination Presets: Tap-to-add buttons for Exact, +₹100, +₹500, +₹2000 with instant Change Due calculation in font-mono.
Current Retrod POS State: POS cash entry relies on standard number input without rapid quick-cash denomination helper buttons.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Cashiers must manually type full cash received instead of rapid one-tap preset additions.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Add quick cash preset buttons ([ Exact ], [ +₹100 ], [ +₹500 ], [ +₹2000 ]) with live change calculation.

PMS Design System Specification: Dynamic UPI QR Code Generation: Dynamic QR code via 'react-qr-code' containing exact invoice amount & UPI VPA, auto-syncing with Customer Display.
Current Retrod POS State: react-qr-code or live dynamic UPI string generator is missing in current POS billing flow.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: No dynamic on-screen UPI QR code rendered for customers to scan directly.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Integrate dynamic UPI string generator + QR code component for seamless Indian UPI payments.

PMS Design System Specification: Hotel Room Charge (PMS Folio Integration): Search active in-house checked-in guest by room/name, validate credit limit, and post directly to room folio.
Current Retrod POS State: Room service manager has room selection, but general POS checkout lacks one-click 'Charge to Room Folio' with guest validation.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Dine-in and bar POS orders cannot directly post charges to a checked-in hotel guest room folio.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Add 'Room Charge' tender option in PaymentModal with room number lookup and folio credit limit validation.

PMS Design System Specification: Secondary Monitor Display: Dedicated customer-facing route (/pos/customer-display) showing real-time basket, discounts, taxes, and grand total.
Current Retrod POS State: POS does not currently have a dedicated customer display route or component.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Dual-screen POS hardware setups have no secondary customer monitor screen.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Create CustomerDisplayFeature component and thin route /pos/customer-display.

PMS Design System Specification: Real-Time Basket Sync: Sync cart items and dynamic UPI QR code to customer screen via BroadcastChannel / localStorage storage events.
Current Retrod POS State: No cross-window storage event sync hook currently implemented.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Customer screen cannot mirror cashier screen updates in real time.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Implement useCustomerDisplaySync hook using BroadcastChannel('pos_customer_display') with localStorage fallback.

PMS Design System Specification: Directory Structure & Thin Routes: Thin routes under src/routes/pos*.tsx, managers under components/shared/pos/, features under features/pos/.
Current Retrod POS State: POS follows thin routes and manager patterns as prescribed in AGENTS.md.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: Follows TanStack Router thin routes and manager component patterns.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Keep new modal and feature additions inside components/shared/pos/ and features/pos/.

PMS Design System Specification: Thermal Invoice Receipt Template: High-density 80mm / 58mm CSS print styling for thermal receipt printers.
Current Retrod POS State: Print stylesheet exists in styles.css (@media print), but dedicated thermal 80mm ESC/POS layout component is missing.
Identified Gaps / Discrepancies: General print styles exist, but formatted thermal receipt component is needed.
Remediation Action Plan (How to Fix): Add standardized InvoiceThermalTemplate component configured for 80mm/58mm thermal rolls.
